1.name: TEXT_CTSOPN52WANDERINGWRITER_00667_WANDERINGWRITER_000_000
1.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! My, my, that I should find you here of all places. Though I suppose that's only right, considering I followed you. My well of inspiration has run dry, you see, and it is my hope that a change of scenery might offer the impetus my work requires.
1.translation_description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Guarda un po' chi incontro qui! Anche se, a ben pensarci, ti ho seguito fin qui: c'era da aspettarselo. La mia vena d'ispirazione si è esaurita e spero che cambiare scenario dia al mio lavoro lo slancio di cui ha bisogno.

2.name: TEXT_CTSOPN52WANDERINGWRITER_00667_WANDERINGWRITER_000_001
2.description: And time again you have proven a knack for finding fascinating locales, with equally fascinating stories unfolding soon after.
2.translation_description: Ancora una volta hai dimostrato di saper trovare luoghi affascinanti, dove poco dopo prendono vita storie altrettanto avvincenti.

3.name: TEXT_CTSOPN52WANDERINGWRITER_00667_WANDERINGWRITER_100_000
3.description: When such a tale finally <hex:021A020203>does<hex:021A020103> unfold, I should very much like to hear it.
3.translation_description: Quando finalmente una storia del genere <hex:021A020203>si svolgerà davvero<hex:021A020103>, mi piacerebbe moltissimo ascoltarla.

4.name: TEXT_CTSOPN52WANDERINGWRITER_00667_WANDERINGWRITER_100_050
4.description: If you've no epic tales to share, perhaps I can regale you with a story of my own.
4.translation_description: Se non hai storie epiche da raccontare, forse posso intrattenerti con una mia.

9.name: TEXT_CTSOPN52WANDERINGWRITER_00667_A1_000_100
9.description: The holy blade, Save the Queen.
9.translation_description: La lama sacra, Save the Queen.

10.name: TEXT_CTSOPN52WANDERINGWRITER_00667_WANDERINGWRITER_500_000
10.description: Battle fought in the mind of a dear companion? How thrilling, how compelling! Please, tell me more.
10.translation_description: Una battaglia combattuta nella mente di un caro compagno? Che emozione, che fascino! Ti prego, raccontami tutto.

11.name: TEXT_CTSOPN52WANDERINGWRITER_00667_WANDERINGWRITER_500_001
11.description: A specter of the late Emperor Varis. I suppose even a figment of one's memory, assuming sufficient creative liberties are taken, can prove as fearsome as a man of flesh and blood.
11.translation_description: Lo spettro del defunto imperatore Varis. Immagino che persino un ricordo, se plasmato da una fervida immaginazione, possa rivelarsi temibile quanto un uomo in carne e ossa.

12.name: TEXT_CTSOPN52WANDERINGWRITER_00667_WANDERINGWRITER_500_002
12.description: Admittedly, I cannot claim to have witnessed his prowess firsthand, but who has not heard tales of his savagery, his unparalleled might?
12.translation_description: A dire il vero, non posso affermare di aver visto con i miei occhi la sua prodezza; ma chi non ha mai sentito parlare della sua ferocia e della sua forza senza pari?

13.name: TEXT_CTSOPN52WANDERINGWRITER_00667_WANDERINGWRITER_500_003
13.description: Yes, I do believe inspiration has struck, my friend. The brutal battle of words which proceeded a nightmarish clash 'twixt the Emperor and the realm's great liberator.
13.translation_description: Sì, credo che l'ispirazione mi abbia finalmente colto, amico mio. La spietata guerra di parole che precedette il terrificante scontro tra l'imperatore e il grande liberatore del regno.

14.name: TEXT_CTSOPN52WANDERINGWRITER_00667_WANDERINGWRITER_500_004
14.description: “You would dare approach me thus?” Lord Varis scoffed. “Where men of greater strength and mind both would flee, you dare commit to such folly?”
14.translation_description: «Osi presentarti così al mio cospetto?» schernì lord Varis. «Dove uomini più forti e saggi fuggirebbero, tu osi perseverare in una simile follia?»

15.name: TEXT_CTSOPN52WANDERINGWRITER_00667_WANDERINGWRITER_500_005
15.description: To which the liberator coolly replied, “How else am I to smite thee save...erm...approaching...”
15.translation_description: A cui il liberatore rispose con calma: «E come potrei colpirti se non... ehm... avvicinandomi?»

16.name: TEXT_CTSOPN52WANDERINGWRITER_00667_WANDERINGWRITER_500_006
16.description: An admirable attempt, if I were still learning my letters perhaps. It seems my prose yet wants for inspiration.
16.translation_description: Un tentativo lodevole, forse... se stessi ancora imparando l'alfabeto. A quanto pare, la mia prosa è ancora a corto d'ispirazione.

17.name: TEXT_CTSOPN52WANDERINGWRITER_00667_WANDERINGWRITER_500_007
17.description: Might you humor me with a more detailed account of your confrontation? I require a more vivid picture if I am to do justice to your deeds.
17.translation_description: Mi faresti la cortesia di raccontarmi lo scontro con più dovizia di particolari? Ho bisogno di immaginarmelo vividamente, se voglio rendere giustizia alle tue gesta.

18.name: TEXT_CTSOPN52WANDERINGWRITER_00667_SYSTEM_500_008
18.description: Idols earned in Memoria Misera (Extreme) can be exchanged for gear and other items by speaking with C'intana in Revenant's Toll.
18.translation_description: Gli idoli ottenuti in Memoria Misera (Estremo) possono essere scambiati con equipaggiamenti e altri oggetti parlando con C'intana al Pedaggio del Redivivo.

19.name: TEXT_CTSOPN52WANDERINGWRITER_00667_WANDERINGWRITER_600_000
19.description: Gunnhildr's Blades were possessed of not one but myriad weapons with which they saved their queen. Oh, to see the look on the Resistance soldiers' faces when Gerolt's work is complete.
19.translation_description: Le Lame di Gunnhildr disponevano di una moltitudine di armi, non di una soltanto, con cui salvarono la loro regina. Oh, quanto vorrei vedere la faccia dei soldati della Resistenza quando Gerolt avrà terminato il suo lavoro!

20.name: TEXT_CTSOPN52WANDERINGWRITER_00667_WANDERINGWRITER_600_001
20.description: Wait. Save the Queen? Why do those words sound so familiar... Yes, of course! Queen Gunnhildr was said to wield a holy blade bearing that name. A rather nonsensical moniker, if I may be so bold, but perhaps in ancient tongues it held some sense of grandeur.
20.translation_description: Aspetta... Save the Queen? Perché queste parole mi suonano così familiari? Ma certo! Si diceva che la regina Gunnhildr impugnasse una lama sacra con quel nome. Un appellativo piuttosto insensato, se posso dirlo, ma forse nelle lingue antiche aveva un che di solenne.

21.name: TEXT_CTSOPN52WANDERINGWRITER_00667_WANDERINGWRITER_600_002
21.description: That Bozjans still speak of her reign with such reverence is testament to their storytelling traditions. Traditions which may very well serve to rekindle the flames of this playwright's spirit.
21.translation_description: Il fatto che i Bozjani parlino ancora del suo regno con tanta reverenza testimonia la loro tradizione narrativa. Una tradizione che potrebbe ravvivare le braci dello spirito di questo drammaturgo.

22.name: TEXT_CTSOPN52WANDERINGWRITER_00667_WANDERINGWRITER_600_003
22.description: Which is to say, there is little I know of the blade save for its name. When I at last find time to sit down and learn all there is to know of the queen and her gallant guard, I shall regale you with a tale unlike any you have heard before.
22.translation_description: In altre parole, della lama so ben poco, a parte il nome. Quando finalmente troverò il tempo di sedermi a scoprire ogni cosa sulla regina e la sua valorosa guardia, ti racconterò una storia come non ne hai mai sentite.

23.name: TEXT_CTSOPN52WANDERINGWRITER_00667_WANDERINGWRITER_600_010
23.description: Ah, yes. The legendary blade, Save the Queen. I happened upon a most fascinating book on its history not long ago.
23.translation_description: Ah, sì. La lama leggendaria, Save the Queen. Non molto tempo fa mi è capitato tra le mani un libro davvero affascinante sulla sua storia.

24.name: TEXT_CTSOPN52WANDERINGWRITER_00667_WANDERINGWRITER_600_011
24.description: It is said this blade, blessed by the gods, could only be wielded by she who would become queen of Bozja. As such, it was passed down through the ages, along with the title of Queen Gunnhildr, serving as undeniable proof of her sovereignty.
24.translation_description: Si dice che questa lama, benedetta dagli dèi, potesse essere impugnata soltanto da colei che sarebbe diventata regina di Bozja. Per questo fu tramandata nei secoli insieme al titolo di regina Gunnhildr, prova inconfutabile della sua sovranità.

25.name: TEXT_CTSOPN52WANDERINGWRITER_00667_WANDERINGWRITER_600_012
25.description: A passage I'm certain you have heard repeated ad nauseam. What I read next, however, was a captivating account of how the queen single-handedly saved her people from certain destruction.
25.translation_description: Una storia che avrai sicuramente sentito ripetere fino alla nausea. Quello che lessi dopo, però, era un resoconto avvincente di come la regina avesse salvato da sola il suo popolo da una distruzione certa.

26.name: TEXT_CTSOPN52WANDERINGWRITER_00667_WANDERINGWRITER_600_013
26.description: The Fourth Umbral Calamity had come in the form of a great and terrible earthquake. The Allagan Empire quickly met its destruction, the earth rising up to swallow it whole. Alas, the destruction would not end with the fall of a single nation.
26.translation_description: La Quarta Calamità Umbrale si manifestò sotto forma di un terremoto immane e terribile. L'Impero Allagano fu presto annientato: la terra si sollevò e lo inghiottì. Ma la distruzione non si arrestò con la caduta di una sola nazione.

27.name: TEXT_CTSOPN52WANDERINGWRITER_00667_WANDERINGWRITER_600_014
27.description: The lands were ablaze with flame, the heavens marred with hues of bloody crimson. Death had come for the people of Bozja, and indeed would claim most as they fled to sanctuary within the castle.
27.translation_description: Le terre ardevano e il cielo si tingeva di rosso sangue. La morte incombeva sul popolo di Bozja e avrebbe reclamato quasi tutte le sue vite, mentre gli abitanti cercavano rifugio nel castello.

28.name: TEXT_CTSOPN52WANDERINGWRITER_00667_WANDERINGWRITER_600_015
28.description: All hope seemed lost... It was then Queen Gunnhildr proclaimed that, if what remained of their home would be saved, the full might of Save the Queen must be brought to bear. A proclamation met with inconsolable tears and lamentations, for her people understood the meaning in it.
28.translation_description: Ogni speranza sembrava perduta... Fu allora che la regina Gunnhildr proclamò che, per salvare ciò che restava della loro patria, avrebbero dovuto sprigionare tutta la potenza di Save the Queen. La sua dichiarazione fu accolta da lacrime inconsolabili e lamenti: il suo popolo ne aveva compreso il significato.

29.name: TEXT_CTSOPN52WANDERINGWRITER_00667_WANDERINGWRITER_600_016
29.description: Taking her blade firmly in hand, the queen quickly thrust it into her breast. Queen Gunnhildr was no more, but in her place stood a goddess, for Save the Queen had taken her body as its vessel.
29.translation_description: La regina strinse saldamente la lama e se la conficcò nel petto. La regina Gunnhildr non esisteva più: al suo posto si ergeva una dea, poiché Save the Queen aveva preso il suo corpo come ricettacolo.

30.name: TEXT_CTSOPN52WANDERINGWRITER_00667_WANDERINGWRITER_600_017
30.description: Her first and final act was to expend every onze of her strength to erect a barrier surrounding what few survivors of Bozja remained.
30.translation_description: Il suo primo e ultimo atto fu erigere una barriera attorno ai pochi superstiti di Bozja, consumando ogni onza della propria forza.

31.name: TEXT_CTSOPN52WANDERINGWRITER_00667_WANDERINGWRITER_600_018
31.description: The magick held true, but when the barrier fell, naught remained but lifeless, desolate landscape. Their only solace being the threat of the Fourth Umbral Calamity had passed.
31.translation_description: La magia resse, ma quando la barriera cadde non restava che un paesaggio desolato e senza vita. Il loro unico conforto era sapere che la minaccia della Quarta Calamità Umbrale era passata.

32.name: TEXT_CTSOPN52WANDERINGWRITER_00667_WANDERINGWRITER_600_019
32.description: In time, the land would heal. Green found its way back to the soil, rainwater replenishing streams and rivers. Life soon followed.
32.translation_description: Con il tempo, la terra si sarebbe risanata. Il verde tornò a coprire il suolo e le piogge ridiedero vita a ruscelli e fiumi. Presto tornò anche la vita.

33.name: TEXT_CTSOPN52WANDERINGWRITER_00667_WANDERINGWRITER_600_020
33.description: All that remained of Bozja was the castle, battered yet unbroken. A monument to Queen Gunnhildr's sacrifice.
33.translation_description: Del regno di Bozja restava soltanto il castello, malconcio ma ancora in piedi: un monumento al sacrificio della regina Gunnhildr.

34.name: TEXT_CTSOPN52WANDERINGWRITER_00667_WANDERINGWRITER_600_021
34.description: Thus ended the reign of Queen Gunnhildr. Though she and her holy blade were no more, they would live on in the memory of her people.
34.translation_description: Così ebbe fine il regno della regina Gunnhildr. Anche se né lei né la sua lama sacra esistevano più, sarebbero vissute nella memoria del suo popolo.

35.name: TEXT_CTSOPN52WANDERINGWRITER_00667_WANDERINGWRITER_600_022
35.description: Touching, is it not? A tale fit for the stage if I ever heard one. Would that I had the time to pen works worthy of her legacy.
35.translation_description: Commovente, vero? Una storia degna del palcoscenico. Magari avessi il tempo di scrivere opere all'altezza della sua eredità.
